name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5
description: Long-context embeddings with Matryoshka support. Flexible dimensions (64-768) and 8K token context.

usage_examples.title: Embed text
usage_examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8082/embed \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5", "input": ["search query text"]}'
